IN THE HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR  RAJASTHAN AT JODHPUR  --------------------------------------------------------
 CRIMINAL MISC. BAIL (CRLMB) No. 9801 of 2016 Petitioner:-

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR  RAJASTHAN AT JODHPUR
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Bheru Lal S/o Khyali Lal Ji, B/c Teli, R/o 23, Jain Boarding Tel Bazar, Police Station Dhan Mandi,
Udaipur.

vs. 
Respondent:-
The State of Rajasthan Date of Order : 25.10.2016

HON'BLE MR. VIJAY BISHNOI, J.
Mr. P.N. Mohanani, for the petitioner.
Mr. Pankaj Avasthi, Public Prosecutor.
 ORDER -----
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner as well as learned Public Prosecutor and also perused the material on record.

The petitioner has been arrested in FIR No. 102/2016 of Police Station, Dhan Mandi, Udaipur for the offence punishable under Sections 420 IPC, 7/16 Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954, 80,
16 Trade & Merchandise Marks Act, 1958 & 64 Copy Right Act 1957 (Amendment Acts 1984 & 1994).
He has preferred this bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C.
Learned Public Prosecutor has opposed the bail application.
Having regard to the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I deem it just and proper to grant bail to the accused petitioner under Section 439 Cr.P.C.

sentences.text: Accordingly, this bail application filed under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed and it is directed that petitioner Bheru Lal S/o Khyali Lal Ji shall be released on bail in connection with FIR No. 102/2016 of Police Station, Dhan Mandi, Udaipur provided he executes a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- with two sound and solvent sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of learned trial court for his appearance before that court on each and every date of hearing and whenever called upon to do so till the completion of the trial.

(VIJAY BISHNOI), J.
